class FooTest {
    @Test
    void clocks() {
        long a = System.currentTimeMillis(); // bad
        long b = System.nanoTime(); // bad
        Date d = new Date(); // bad
        LocalDate day = LocalDate.now(); // bad
        Instant at = Instant.now(); // bad
        LocalDateTime z = LocalDateTime.now(ZoneId.of("UTC")); // bad
        Instant utc = Instant.now(Clock.systemUTC()); // bad
        LocalDate sys = LocalDate.now(Clock.systemDefaultZone()); // bad
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance(); // bad
    }
}
